entries.english: {camp.next.line}. Every win opens the road farther.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[37].nodes[7].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A frost-warden - the Ice Wolf. Steady and tough.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[2].nodes[0].options[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A hearth-hound - the Flame Pup. Fierce and fast.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[2].nodes[0].options[2].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A heart-ward - the Aether Sprite. Quick and arcane.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[2].nodes[0].options[4].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A new Echo has answered! Set it to a harvest - wood, iron or grain - and it will tend the work on its own.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[25].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A talent point is yours, Keeper. Open Hero, then Skills, and spend it on something you can use.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[28].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A thought, Keeper: a town needs proper steel. Set up a spot to buy weapons - raise the Forge, the weaponsmith's roof, when you are ready.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[33].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A thousand honest swords, Keeper. Not one great one. That is the bargain I keep.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[10].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.
JSON field 'dialogues[12].nodes[1].options[3].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Beyond the Heart lie hostile camps holding resources Elarion needs. Break their defences and bring those resources home.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[36].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Beyond the walls there are no towers - only you and me. Two fights. Always know which one you are in.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[17].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Bring me herbs and I'll bring you back from anything. Step up to the bench.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[13].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Build a thing, and the thing gives back. You'll see.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[19].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.
JSON field 'dialogues[12].nodes[0].options[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Careful hands, Keeper - everything on this bench remembers a purpose. Rings, amulets, stones that still hold a little light.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[14].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Coin enough to build, Keeper. Walls don't raise themselves - put it to work.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[26].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Come in out of the wind, dearie. There is bread, and there is always a chair.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[5].nodes[1].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Come with me, Keeper - the gate first. Stay close; I will show you the way.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[29].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Come, have a look before the good pieces go.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[9].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.
JSON field 'dialogues[12].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.
JSON field 'dialogues[12].nodes[0].options[2].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Emberhand. Yes, that Emberhand. Mind the broken hilt on the anvil - it does not move.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[10].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Every victory opens the road farther. Choose your target - stronger footholds carry greater risk and richer spoils.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[36].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Fresh stock off the morning carts, Keeper - tools, trinkets, and whatever the caravans dared to carry through the Dimming.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[9].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Get my stones turning again. Empty bellies, empty walls - it has never been more complicated than that.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[5].nodes[1].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Good steel wants good armor. An Armorer next, perhaps - in your own time, Keeper.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[34].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Good. You got it. Build a thing, and the thing gives back.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[30].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: He fades back toward the trees. I'll be in the treeline when you change your mind, Keeper. You will.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[3].nodes[6].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: He lowers the bow, and something in his shoulders eases. Then it's settled. I walk where you walk, Keeper - and I put an arrow in whatever finds us first.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[3].nodes[5].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Heartfire is the Heart's strength beyond its own reach. You hold three, and each one sends you on a raid - one rekindles every four hours.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[38].nodes[1].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Here is the shape of it: drive the dark back from the Heart and the tree grows. A brighter Heart is a stronger Heart - and the echoes gather more for you while you fight.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[4].nodes[1].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Hold - easy. Keep your hand off that hilt; if I wanted you down you'd not have heard me at all.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[3].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Horns! Here they come - to the gate, Keeper!
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[15].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: I can farm. I can mend. Put me to work, Keeper.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[18].nodes[0].lines[2].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: I can read a trail three days cold. You can hold a wall. Apart, we each lose slow. Together, maybe we don't.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[3].nodes[3].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: I knew the people who gave themselves to that tree. Some of those Echoes were friends. So I keep the wild off the wall, and I don't ask for thanks.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[3].nodes[1].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: If you mean to, the board has the threads. Mind the dark.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[1].nodes[2].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: I'll return when I can take another.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[2].nodes[0].options[6].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: I'm Sylas - Scout of the Reach. And I don't trail just anyone through these trees.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[3].nodes[2].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: In town they come in WAVES, at the gates. Your towers hold the line - and you fight beside them.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[15].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: It already knows how to fight, Keeper. What it does not know is when you want it to.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[41].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: I've had eyes on you since the treeline. You're the new Keeper. The Heart's been louder since you came - even out here I felt it stir.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[3].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Lead on. Let's see what the dark side of this land is hiding.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[3].nodes[5].lines[2].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Levels change what a troop can do. Footman {footman.next} - and upgrading costs only time.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[37].nodes[4].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Mark this, Keeper. In town they come in waves, at your gates, and your towers stand with you.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[17].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Mind the fumes, Keeper - every tincture on this bench is a small argument with the Dimming.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[13].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Mind where you put your boots, Keeper. Young roots under there, and they have had a hard century.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[6].nodes[1].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: New steel in your pack? Iron serves no one in a chest - equip it.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[27].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.
JSON field 'dialogues[37].nodes[4].options[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: No one walks the cottage dark. Take a torch - and mind it burning.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[39].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.
JSON field 'dialogues[2].nodes[0].options[7].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Now the rest - the forge, the farm, the market. Lay them out; this town is yours.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[22].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.
JSON field 'dialogues[37].nodes[7].options[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Open Journey, then Raids, when you are ready to march.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[35].nodes[0].lines[2].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[23].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Plate, mail, and good boiled leather, Keeper - armor that holds when the wall does not.
entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[11].nodes[0].lines[0].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.context: JSON field 'dialogues[24].nodes[0].lines[1].text'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Recruits sharpen by the hour, Keeper. Give the word and they'll march - Elarion's walls won't hold themselves.

entries.english: Take your due - a defender earns their keep.

entries.english: I am going. The Wound is louder than the Heart now. I have left a thing in the cellar for whoever is next - a seed. Plant it at the Folk's table, if there is anyone to plant it. It will grow into something old and quiet. The Folk used to say there were trees like it once, before any of us. Maybe one of them will remember the song.

entries.english: If anyone reads this - I am going to the Wound. I am going to try one more thing. The Heart will hold while I am gone. The Heart always holds.

entries.english: The dreams are back. The Wound, calling. I am not the same in the mornings. Mira would have known what to say. I miss her hands.

entries.english: The folk came again today. The well at Carrow's edge is going bad. Crystals work on the early signs but the late ones - I don't know yet. I came here to learn the green ways. I am still learning.
entries.context: JSON field 'loreStones[0].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Folk who came from the village this week: Wren's boy, the miller's wife, the two children of Carrow. I told them what I had. The well is poisoned, I know that now. It is not anything I can name. It is older than the names I have.
entries.context: JSON field 'loreStones[1].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Heart will hold. The Heart always holds.
entries.context: JSON field 'loreStones[3].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The seed is not the only thing I leave. There is a thing I have not written plainly anywhere, and I will not write it plainly here. If you have come this deep, you have read enough to know the shape of it. Mira walked the green ways first. I followed her into them. I am following her still.

entries.english: A pair only counts when you own both Echoes and both are assigned to the resource they favor. Each Echo card carries its pair line: either the synergy is ACTIVE, or it names the partner you still need.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[14].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A raid runs on a clock. When it ends you are scored up to three stars on how far you broke the camp, and paid resources to match. Raids stay closed until you have a Barracks and at least one trained troop.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[16].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A short trip to the Market is often the fastest way to fix a gap in your kit between fights.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[29].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A solid Workshop keeps the village self-sufficient, less buying, more making.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[26].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A steady Quarry means you are never stalled on Stone when you want to train or upgrade.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[23].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: A thriving Hollow means a thriving workforce, which means more resources flowing in for everything else you want to build.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[25].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Affinity is a bonus, never a lock. You choose what each Echo gathers from the five chips on their card -- Wood, Iron, Food, Gold or Crystals -- and every chip is always tappable. Assign whatever your village is short of.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[13].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: An Echo is the awakened essence of one of the people the Heart of Elarion guards. The world tree remembers every soul it has kept, and when a new defender rises it wakes them to work beside you. They are not elementals and not pets -- they are the realm's remembered, lending a hand.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[12].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Approach a person, gate, building, or glowing object and an interact prompt appears. That single button opens dialogue, shops, the build menu, or a region crossing depending on what you are facing.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[0].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: At the very center of the village stands the Heart of Elarion, the world tree and stone reliquary that everything else protects. It is the source of the realm's life force and the home the waves are trying to reach.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[21].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Back home, the realm strikes back in waves. Each wave opens with a prepare phase, a countdown to ready your defenses, then enemies march in from the gates toward the Heart of Elarion. You and your defenses hold them off; clear the wave to win, but let the Heart fall and the run ends.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[11].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Because leveling pays out both raw power and Wisdom, every fight moves you forward twice: better numbers now, and a deeper skill build over time.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[7].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Beside the grid, a live 3D preview of your hero, the Gear Preview, shows exactly how your current loadout looks. Change a piece and the hero updates in place, so you always see what you are wearing.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[4].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Build and upgrade it to raise its yield. As a resource building, its upgrade path is about level and output, more Crystals flowing in over time, so investing here pays for everything else.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[22].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Combat is real-time and built around movement. Kite, reposition, and time your abilities: open with your basic attack, weave in your signatures and hot-swap skills, and heal or control when the pressure spikes. Clear every enemy to win.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[10].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Coming back to the Forge as you level is how you keep your weapon matched to the fights ahead.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[27].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Completing the roster pays again. Once all six Echoes are awake, everything they gather is lifted. Recruiting is the biggest single jump in your economy, bigger than levelling any one Echo.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[14].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Conversations use a clean dialogue box, one speaker and their line at a time, with choices when they matter. Some options only appear once you have done the right thing or hold the right item, so coming back to a character later can open new threads.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[2].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Crafting turns raw resources and gathered materials into gear and consumables. Instead of only buying equipment, you can build it, and crafted gear comes in tiers, from Common up through finer, master, and legendary grades that scale its stats.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[5].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Different crafts live in different places: weapon and armor recipes at the smiths, jewelry at the Jeweler, and potions and food via the village's consumable recipes. Some of the best recipes also call for special materials you earn from quests.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[5].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Drop in to browse what is for sale, pick up consumables and gear, and sell surplus back for resources. It keeps your inventory and your resource bins flowing in both directions.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[29].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Dungeons are built room by room and entered from the world. The starter run is a loop: a corridor into a four-way junction, then a ring of rooms that bends back around to where you branched off.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[19].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Each channel runs two jobs at once on a new village. Anything beyond that waits in line and starts on its own the moment a slot frees, so queueing more than you can run costs you nothing.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[15].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Each level makes you stronger in two ways. It raises your ability damage, so the same skills hit harder the more you fight, and it grants Wisdom, the points you spend in the Skill Tree. Early levels give a steady trickle of Wisdom, and later levels give a little more.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[7].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Echoes gather whether you are playing or away. Their take pools in a shared silo that fills for a set number of hours and then stops. Tap Collect All when you return to bank it and restart the clock. That come-back-and-claim rhythm is the loop.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[12].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Echoes work better in the right company. Three named pairs each lift ALL of your harvest while they are running: Provisions (Elowen and Aldwin), Forge (Doran and Maren), and Fortune (Corvin and Bran).
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[14].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Enemies belong to their rooms. They wake when you step into their space and settle back home if you leave, so you meet them a room at a time instead of dragging the whole floor behind you.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[19].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Every Echo has an affinity, the one resource they favor. Their card names it on the Favors line, and the matching chip in the picker is labelled 'best -- this Echo's calling'.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[13].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Every weapon, armor set, and accessory carries a rarity, from Common and Uncommon up through Rare, Epic, and Legendary, and rarity scales the item's power. Weapons raise your damage, armor adds defense and bonus health, and accessories (rings and amulets) round out your build.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[6].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Everything that takes time runs through one place: the Work Queue. Building and upgrading, training troops, and researching upgrades each get their own channel -- Builders, Training and Research -- and the channels never take slots from one another.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[15].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Heartfire is the Heart of Elarion reaching past its own borders to keep an expedition alive, and each one sends you on a raid. You hold up to three. It is not a resource: nothing produces it, nothing sells it, nothing else can spend it, and no amount of anything will buy one.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[17].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Home is the castle hub, with the Outer World streaming in around it so you can walk straight out into the realm. The world is built as connected regions joined by natural, diegetic crossings, a bridge, a tunnel, a mountain pass, rather than invisible walls.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[3].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Invest in the Tower when you want the village itself to fight back with arcane power, not just your hero.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[31].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Keep the Heart standing and keep it strong. Driving enemies back feeds its life force, which heals the world and quickens your Echoes' harvest.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[21].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Levels change what a troop can do, not just how hard it hits. The Footman learns Sweeping Cut at L3, Warden's Roar at L5 and Champion's Combo at L7, and every troop has its own ladder. Upgrade from the same Troops card - the line under UPGRADE names the next unlock.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[18].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Like the Forge, it both sells gear and runs an upgrade flow, so you can buy a fresh set and improve the one you wear. Better armor means more defense and more bonus health to heal through.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[28].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Like the other resource buildings, the Quarry upgrades along a yield path: each level produces more Stone over time. It keeps your Barracks climbing and your army growing.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[23].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Many pieces have a level requirement and a class fit, so a weapon meant for one hero will not slot onto another. Gear is bought with the realm's resources, Wood, Iron, Food, and Crystals, so your economy directly feeds your power.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[6].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Nodes come in two flavors. Skill nodes unlock a brand-new ability you can equip; stat nodes give permanent passive boosts like more damage, defense, or health. Alongside each hero's own tree there is a small pool of shared, universal nodes any hero can take.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[8].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Note on what is coming: the deeper base-building layer, freely placing and upgrading your own towers and walls, and converting cleared outposts into garrisoned bases that troops auto-defend, is a V2 feature still being built. For now, focus on holding the line with your hero as the waves test the village.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[11].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Objectives advance as you do the thing they ask. Finish a step and the card updates to the next one; finish the last step and the quest completes and pays out. You never have to guess what to do next.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[1].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: On Android the game opens on one simple choice: connect a wallet, or play as guest. Both take you straight in, and Play as Guest always works.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[20].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: On the field you deploy. Tap a troop tile to pick a unit, then tap the ground to drop one. Set a rally point to pull your troops toward a spot, or call a Retreat to pull the survivors out. Your hero fights alongside them.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[16].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: On top of that sits the hot-swap skill bar, a row of extra slots you fill yourself with abilities you unlock in the Skill Tree. This is how the tree pays off in combat: unlock a skill, then drag it into a slot to bring it into the fight.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[9].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: One charge rekindles every four hours, whether the game is open or not, and the pool stacks to three - a day away from the game is never wasted. A charge is spent when you set out, so a raid costs one whether you win or lose. With none left the Heart is not ready to send you back yet, and the raid door tells you how long the wait is.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[17].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Out in the world you will find enemy outposts and wandering threats. Closing on one starts a battle. Clearing them pushes the darkness back, which strengthens the world tree and speeds your Echoes' harvest, so exploring is never just sightseeing.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[3].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Pick a recipe, check the cost and any special components it needs, and tap Craft. The panel shows exactly what a recipe requires next to what you own, and flags anything you are short on, so there is no guesswork. A successful craft drops the new item straight into your inventory, ready to equip.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[5].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Plentiful Wood keeps crafting cheap and your defenses well supplied.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[24].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Push to the deepest room and you will find a treasure cache. It asks before it opens and it pays once per run: torch materials, plus herbs for a Mending Salve. Clearing it the first time also teaches you the torch recipe.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[19].body[3]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Quests are how the story of Elarion unfolds and how you earn many of your rewards. You pick them up by talking to people in the village and the world. Each quest runs through a chain of stages, and each stage has a clear objective and a reward when you clear it.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[2].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Raids are where your trained troops earn their keep. Open Journey, choose Raids, pick a target camp from the list, and you are taken straight there. There is no march; you arrive at the edge of the enemy camp.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[16].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Set an Echo to the resource they favor and they bring in noticeably more of it. Set them anywhere else and they still work, just without the match bonus. Reassigning is free and takes effect at once.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[13].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Step inside and you can shop for gear, sell what you have outgrown, and run the upgrade flow to improve your equipment. The Forge is one of the buildings that does double duty, a store and a smithy in one.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[27].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Tap the tracker card to open the full quest log and see everything you have available, active, and completed.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[1].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Arcane Tower was built by the first Keepers and holds the ward-stones that answer your call. It is the realm's most imposing structure, the tallest silhouette in the village and its sturdiest, with the most health of any building.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[31].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Armorer is the realm's dedicated smith for protection, where the Folk shape iron into the plate that keeps you standing through a wave. Where the Forge leans toward your weapon, the Armorer is your place for armor.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[28].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Builders chip on the right of the screen is your at-a-glance readout: how many slots are busy and how long until the next one frees. Tap it to open the queue and see every running and waiting job.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[15].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Crystal Mine taps the gem-sap that seeps from the Heart into the stone, producing Crystals, the realm's premium resource for shops, gear, and upgrades. It is one of your economy's cornerstones.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[22].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Echo Hollow is an ancient recess in the world tree's roots where the Echoes rest between their work, their presence a low hum in the stones. It is the home of your gathering spirits.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[25].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Forge is the smith's fire that never cools, where raw iron is beaten into plate the Hollowed cannot easily bite through. It is your weapons-and-gear smith: a place to both buy equipment and upgrade what you carry.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[27].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Heart is more than a target. It releases the Echoes that gather for you, and it sets the village's tier, the gate that unlocks higher building upgrades as your home grows. As danger rises during a defense, the Heart even speaks, a living warning that a lane is breaking.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[21].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Inventory is where you view and equip everything you own. It is laid out as tabs over a grid: Weapons, Armor, Accessories, and Consumables. Tap any item to see its stats and the actions you can take, Equip, Use, or Drop.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[4].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Jeweler specializes in the accessories that round out your build, the rings and amulets that fill your hero's two accessory slots. It is a shop, and the home of the realm's finer crafted trinkets.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[30].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The loop is simple and it always comes home: leave the hub to explore and fight, win resources and gear, then return to grow the village and your hero. Push the dark back and the realm heals a little more each time.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[0].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Lumber Mill cuts timber into planks, producing Wood, the most common building and crafting resource and the bones of your walls and gear. Its blade hums against the timber the green places of Elarion still spare.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[24].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Market is the village's trading floor, where you buy and sell goods. It is a shop building, your place to convert resources into the items you want and to offload what you do not need.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[29].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Off-Hand slot is reserved for shields, keeping sword-and-board distinct from a heavier weapon. A shield is real armor, not decoration: every one carries a defense value, and the stronger shields ask for a higher hero level. Your total damage reduction from all your gear is capped, so a balanced set beats stacking a single slot.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[6].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Quarry cuts the bedrock the Heart wills up beneath your town, producing Stone for the realm. Stone is one of the core resources your Barracks spends to grow your army.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[23].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The shops do not waste your time. The Forge and the Armorer show only what you can equip right now, for your class and at your level, a couple of choices per level, so the shelf grows as you do. The Jeweler shows accessories you have not reached yet, marked 'Requires Lv N'. Use the Gear Preview to see and compare a loadout on your hero before you commit.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[6].body[3]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Skill Tree is where you shape your hero. You spend Wisdom, earned from leveling and victories, to unlock nodes across four tiers, climbing from the basics up to powerful tier-four capstones. Higher tiers cost more Wisdom and sit behind the nodes below them.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[8].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The wallet is used to sign in and nothing else: this build makes no purchases and moves no funds. You can start as a guest and connect later, and your progress comes with you.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[20].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The waves escalate in story and scale, from the first scattered Hollowed to orc warbands, troll brutes, and a dragon at the apex. Beating waves is also how your Echo workforce grows, so defending home directly feeds your economy.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[11].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The Workshop is where the Folk make what the Keeper needs and ask nothing in return. It is the village's general crafting and production hall, hammer and forge working together.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[26].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: There are six in all: Aldwin, Elowen, Corvin, Bran, Doran and Maren. You begin with one, and every five waves you clear wakes another, up to the full roster of six. More Echoes means more gathered, so defending home directly feeds your economy.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[12].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: There are story quests that carry the main tale, gear quests that lead you toward better equipment, and side quests for extra resources. The Quest Tracker follows one at a time; the quest log lists them all with their progress.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[2].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: These crossings are Region Gates. Walk up to one, step onto the threshold, and the gate carries you across the seam into the next region. Some warp you, some stream the next area in around you, but they always read as a real place you walk through.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[3].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Think of the Hollow as the heart of your passive economy, the place tied to the Echo workforce that grows as you clear waves. It grounds the spirits that keep harvesting while you fight and while you are away.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[25].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: This is the heart of your build. Want to lean into survival, burst, or sustain? The tree lets you commit, and unlocked abilities then go onto your skill bar (see Hot-Swap).
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[8].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Unlike the resource and shop buildings, the Tower upgrades along a spells path: its own system of magical wards and powers, damage-over-time, area effects, and mana, that you research and improve. It is your magical backbone for the defense.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[31].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Upgrade it along its yield path to bring in more Wood per cycle. Wood is also one of the things your Echoes harvest, so the Lumber Mill and your workforce both feed the same pile.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[24].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Use it as a hub for turning your resources into useful goods. As your village tier rises at the Heart, the Workshop and its kin can be upgraded for better output.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[26].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Visit the Armorer when fights start hitting harder than your current set can absorb.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[28].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Visit to buy accessories and to craft jewelry from your materials. Accessories add bonus health and other perks on top of your weapon and armor, the finishing touches on a loadout.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[30].body[1]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: When you close on an enemy in the world, the screen fades and you drop into an isolated battle arena, just your hero against a small family of foes, usually one to three, with a rare chance of a boss. There are no buildings in the way; it is a clean, open space to fight in.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[10].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: When your weapon and armor are solid, the Jeweler is where you squeeze out that extra edge.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[30].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Why bother? Crystals gate the rarer gear and the deeper upgrades, so a healthy mine quietly funds your whole build.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[22].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Win and you are rated with stars based on how fast and clean you fought: a quick finish earns three stars, a solid one two, and a win at any pace one. More stars multiply your rewards, XP, Wisdom, resources, and a better shot at gear. Then you warp back to where you were, the world a little safer.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[10].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: You arrange the hot-swap bar out of combat. Drag a skill onto a slot, or move it between slots to taste, and it locks in for your next battle. In the fight, each slot has its own cooldown, so your custom kit plays right alongside your class signatures.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[9].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: You can always leave. The way out is marked by a lit EXIT beacon: a beam of light and a plain EXIT sign you can pick out from across the room. Walk back to it whenever you have had enough.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[19].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: You play one hero, the Keeper of Elarion, and you control only the Keeper. Everything else in the realm acts on its own, so you are never juggling a squad. Walk with WASD, the arrow keys, a gamepad stick, or the on-screen joystick on touch and web builds. The camera follows you while you explore.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[0].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Your current goal is always one glance away. The Quest Tracker card on the right edge of the screen shows the quest you are following and the exact step in front of you, like 'Speak with the Village Elder' or 'Clear the outpost.'
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[1].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Your first Barracks raises a free squad of Footmen. That squad is the door to raids, not the whole army: the army holds more slots than the free squad fills, and every empty slot is a fighter you did not bring. Fill them from Manage, then Troops - training costs only time.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[18].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Your hero earns experience by defeating enemies. Cross a threshold and you level up instantly, with no break in the action. The XP bar on the HUD shows how close you are to the next level.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[7].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Your hero fights with two sets of abilities. The fixed class kit is your bread and butter: a basic attack that is always there, plus three signature abilities that define your class. That kit is your reliable baseline.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[9].body[0]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Your hero has five equip slots: Main Hand for your weapon, Off-Hand for a shield, an Armor set, a Ring, and an Amulet. The Off-Hand only accepts shields, so a sword and shield stay clearly delineated from a two-handed grip.
entries.context: JSON field 'sections[4].body[2]'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Your wallet is your save. Connect one and your progress is kept against it, so the same wallet on another device picks up where you left off. Guest progress stays on this device until you connect.

entries.english: Region 1 - the first region beyond Elarion. A deep, choked forest whose canopy keeps out the sun; its enemy mix skews nature and poison. A low bestWave gate means a player who has held the village for a few waves discovers the road out early. The Thornwood's main objective is a five-wave forest defense of a young Heart-sapling.
entries.context: JSON field 'regions[0].description'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Region 2 - a drowned, venomous swamp downriver of the Thornwood. Stagnant water and creeping rot; the mire itself is venomous and its denizens wear that venom as a weapon. Discovered only after the Thornwood is cleared. A six-wave defense.
entries.context: JSON field 'regions[1].description'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Region 3 - a glacier-locked hollow past the Mirewood, where the cold never breaks. Its creatures move slow and certain, like the slow grind of the ice itself. Discovered only after the Mirewood is cleared. A seven-wave defense.
entries.context: JSON field 'regions[2].description'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Region 4 - cracked, magma-veined badlands beyond the frost. Black earth bleeding magma; the things here treat heat the way other creatures treat air. The hard region. Discovered only after Hollowfrost Vale is cleared. An eight-wave defense.
entries.context: JSON field 'regions[3].description'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: Region 5 - the far frontier, where the sky tore open and the stars fell through. Reality is thin here, and what crosses over wears starlight like armour. The last and hardest region. Discovered only after the Emberwastes is cleared. A ten-wave defense.
entries.context: JSON field 'regions[4].description'; classify as player copy, protected name, or internal data.

entries.english: The home base - the village the Keeper tends and the Heart, Elarion, at its centre. Not a region: it has no gate and is never cleared. All persistent buildings, the economy, towers, walls and pets live here, and the player always returns. The Realm Map is the world Elarion sits inside, reached from the village Wayshrine.
